assessment.reason: All four channels show low 1x (0.0007-0.0018) ruling out unbalance and looseness references which show 1x typically 0.004-0.018 on all channels. RMS 0.033-0.039, crest ~4.5-7.3, kurtosis ~3.2-3.4 are low, no impact signature, matching normal references. 2x is modestly elevated on ch0/ch2 (~0.0041) vs ch1/ch3 (~0.0008/0.0013), but absolute 2x magnitude matches normal trial (e.g. normal 0.00323/0.00271 on ch0/ch2) more closely than typical misalignment references (0.006-0.015 on ch0/ch2). 3x also low. Limitation: single short radial recording cannot uniquely separate normal from mild misalignment; 2x-dominant pattern on ch0/ch2 overlaps with one mild misalignment reference, so mild misalignment cannot be fully excluded.
